fusions.name: Kicked Hive
fusions.desc: Stamps a hive open, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Left in the Wound
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. A horn strike that deals 8 damage and leaves its tip in the wound, making the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Milk and Honey
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Dawn to Dusk
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 1 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
